bullets.body: The broader humanoid factory-deployment cohort closed the business-week fourth day with Boston Dynamics Atlas advancing on its longest continuous-operation milestone curve and the OEM-adopter roster moving from eight to nine on the back of a fresh Friday-morning signing. A Friday Robot Report note reported the BMW Group Spartanburg 30-unit Atlas pilot clearing the first North American 192-hour continuous-operation milestone on the assembly-line under-body conveyor task with zero MTBF-impacting incidents — the longest continuous-operation milestone the BMW Spartanburg pilot has cleared and the first eight-day mark in the North American cohort — and now operating in the run toward a first North American 216-hour milestone. A Friday Decrypt note reported Volkswagen's Wolfsburg Atlas pilot edging to roughly 99 units on the body-shop welding-jig material-handoff task as the fifth weekday shift carried the business-week's expansion pattern through the pre-weekend close, with the humanoid league-table OEM-adopter roster's ninth flagged adopter — Renault Group Cleon — moving from due-diligence to a signed 25-unit pilot commitment, lifting the roster to nine and giving the cohort its third consecutive day with a new OEM signing. A Friday Standard Bots note reported Hyundai Metaplant's Dangjin rolling-mill cycle-time improvement holding near 5.3 percent for an eleventh consecutive within-band day with a small one-tenth-of-a-percent tightening on top of Thursday's reading, with the policy-distillation pipeline behind the cycle-time gains continuing to run on the Tenstorrent Galaxy plus Unsloth router-only stack and now executing the canonical two-paper conformance reference run on every policy-update cycle.

bullets.body: A Friday arxiv release (2605.08147) closed the business-week research cycle by adding an operator-side compliance-monitoring evaluation companion to the now-doubly-cleared loader-verification reference set, walking the per-operator compliance-monitoring telemetry across the first 24 hours of the federal-civilian directive's compliance-monitoring phase and tabulating the per-operator attestation-event arithmetic the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle has now been waiting on. The paper, positioned as a second applied-deployment companion rather than a fresh formal model, applies the 2605.07891 consolidation-survey reference set plus Thursday's 2605.08019 applied-deployment evaluation companion to the n-of-eleven operator sample's compliance-monitoring telemetry from the directive's first post-deadline operating day, and reports per-operator attestation-event rates landing inside the consolidation survey's predicted bounds for a third consecutive cross-section sample. A Friday Simon Willison note characterized the paper as the canonical operator-side close on the loader-verification line and observed that the timing — released the same business day as the CISA federal-civilian compliance-monitoring phase opened and the FMRB classified-annex record cleared eight-of-eight — completes the seven-document reference set the framework cohort's mid-June default-shipment release-candidate cycle can cite as a single coherent academic-plus-deployment-plus-compliance-monitoring end-to-end reference. A Friday andrew.ooo reading observed the operator-side compliance-monitoring companion extends the existing DeepMind plus Meta AI plus Anthropic plus Microsoft consolidated reference-implementation index by a compliance-monitoring telemetry overlay covering the eleven-operator sample, giving the framework cohort a directly citable compliance-monitoring measurement artifact alongside the applied-deployment evaluation companion and the consolidation survey.
